import subprocess, os, sys
root=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo'
py=os.path.join(root,'Scripts','python.exe')
if not os.path.exists(py):
    cp=subprocess.run(['python','-m','venv',root],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
    if cp.returncode: raise RuntimeError('venv fail: '+cp.stderr)
cp=subprocess.run([py,'-m','pip','install','--disable-pip-version-check','rasterio','pyproj'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
print('PIP_RC='+str(cp.returncode))
print(cp.stdout[-3000:])
if cp.returncode: print(cp.stderr[-3000:]); raise RuntimeError('pip install failed')
cp=subprocess.run([py,'-c',"import rasterio,pyproj,numpy; print('rasterio='+rasterio.__version__); print('pyproj='+pyproj.__version__); print('numpy='+numpy.__version__)"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(cp.stdout.strip())
if cp.returncode: raise RuntimeError(cp.stderr)
print('GEO_VENV_READY='+py)
